goal: Predict how long a New York City yellow-taxi trip will take from what is known at pickup, on a reproducible, monitored, low-cost platform that a small team can run.

functional.title: Ingest a TLC month and verify it before it lands
functional.detail: Download the monthly file, check required columns by type family, record a manifest (SHA-256, rows), land it in the lakehouse; idempotent re-runs.

functional.title: Clean and de-duplicate trips with documented quality rules
functional.detail: Drop charge/reversal duplicates and voids; enforce month, duration, distance, speed and zone rules, each justified by EDA.

functional.title: Publish an ML feature table with an enforced contract
functional.detail: Gold trip_features with fixed columns and types (dbt contract), mirrored in libs/contracts.

functional.title: Provide BI marts for analysts
functional.detail: Demand and pace by weekday x hour, daily volume, pickup-zone activity; reconciled to gold.

functional.title: Version every dataset the model trains on
functional.detail: Raw files in DVC; gold snapshots content-addressed by SHA-256 and verified on read.

functional.title: Train and compare models on an honest split
functional.detail: Temporal train/validation/test split; mean baseline, RandomForest (required), Optuna-tuned LightGBM; RMSE, MAE, R2 and slice metrics.

functional.title: Promote a model only when it is genuinely better
functional.detail: Champion re-scored on the challenger's test week; >= 0.5% better RMSE, no slice > 5% worse; previous champion kept for rollback.

functional.title: Predict a trip's duration through an API
functional.detail: POST /predict with the TripFeatures contract returns minutes plus model name and version.

functional.title: Let anyone try it in a web page, with zone names
functional.detail: Form with pickup/dropoff zones by name, distance and NYC time; shows the estimate and model version.

functional.title: Run the whole loop automatically every month
functional.detail: Ingest -> lakehouse -> gold snapshot -> asset event -> train -> gate -> portal snapshot, on a timer.

functional.title: Detect data and model drift
functional.detail: PSI per feature and on the target, champion RMSE on the newer month, retraining recommendation.

functional.title: Show every department's work in one portal
functional.detail: Overview for the owner, one section per department, live numbers from the pipeline.

non_functional.title: Beat a naive baseline by a wide margin
non_functional.detail: Test-week RMSE well below the mean baseline (target < 50% of baseline).

non_functional.title: Fast predictions, acceptable cold start
non_functional.detail: Warm prediction under 100 ms; first request after idle under 10 s.
non_functional.measured: ~10 ms warm, 3.3-3.5 s cold (laptop), ~3.9 s on the server.

non_functional.title: Near-zero resources while idle
non_functional.detail: Compute containers stopped when unused; only a small gateway stays on.

non_functional.title: Any model can be traced to its exact data and code
non_functional.detail: Locked dependencies, digest-pinned images, snapshot SHA-256 and git commit on every MLflow run.

non_functional.title: Bad data is stopped, not modelled
non_functional.detail: Raw contract at ingestion, quality rules in silver, dbt tests on gold and marts.

non_functional.title: No secrets in code, least privilege everywhere
non_functional.detail: Secret scanning on every commit and full history in CI; file-based secrets; non-root, read-only containers; socket proxy for Docker.

non_functional.title: Known vulnerabilities blocked before release
non_functional.detail: Every image scanned; fixable high/critical CVEs fail CI; security updates refreshed at least daily.

non_functional.title: The public site cannot be abused easily
non_functional.detail: Route allow-list, per-client rate limits, 2 KB bodies, strict security headers.

non_functional.title: Keep serving when dependencies are down
non_functional.detail: API serves its cached model when MLflow is unreachable; failed model loads never replace a working model.

non_functional.title: Loosely coupled components with explicit contracts
non_functional.detail: Components share only versioned schemas, table contracts and registry aliases; each can be replaced alone.

non_functional.title: Every change is tested before it can ship
non_functional.detail: Hooks, strict typing, >= 85% coverage, dbt tests, DAG tests, image smoke tests; CD only from green main.

non_functional.title: Old artifacts do not pile up
non_functional.detail: Weekly clean-up keeps the newest 10 tagged images per package in GHCR (with their untagged child manifests) and, on the server, every image in use plus the previous release.
non_functional.measured: GHCR keeps 10 per image; server keeps in-use + 2 newest per taxi-* repository.
